name: Ricardo Morales
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for auto mechanics, fueled by his father's work at a local garage in Lima. He honed his skills through years of hands-on experience, specializing in meticulous component inspection and problem-solving. While his formal education might be limited, Ricardo's innate understanding of mechanical systems and dedication to precision make him a valuable asset to any team.

He joined the team seeking to apply his knack for identifying flaws and ensuring top-notch quality. Ricardo is determined to climb the ranks and demonstrate his commitment to excellence. He believes that even the smallest details can make a significant difference in performance, and he's always eager to learn new techniques and technologies.

physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when concentrating.
Insists on using traditional measuring tools alongside digital ones.
